categories.name: Data source and universe
categories.definition: Choosing which file to read and treating its contents as the full analysis population, with no scoping beyond the file itself.
categories.criterion: If the decision is which raw input to load or that its whole contents are the sample, it goes here; once specific rows are excluded it is cohort_filtering.

categories.name: Which observations are kept
categories.definition: Removing rows from the analysis sample via inclusion thresholds, subset restrictions, or complete-case dropping of records with missing fields.
categories.criterion: The decision drops observations from a sample; if it instead alters values within kept rows it is value_cleaning.

categories.name: Missingness and type coercion
categories.definition: Detecting missing tokens, converting string fields to numeric, or imputing values while keeping every row.
categories.criterion: The operation transforms or fills cell values without deriving a new analytic measure and without dropping rows.

categories.name: Derived measures
categories.definition: Computing a new information-preserving variable from raw fields by a largely mechanical rule, such as age from birthdate, averaging raters, or a numeric clustering id.
categories.criterion: The mapping preserves granularity and hinges on a formula/reference choice; if it lumps values or imposes a boundary it is categorization_and_cutoffs.

categories.name: Coarsening and coding
categories.definition: Reducing granularity through grouping, cutoffs, or binary coding where the boundary or default itself is a judgment: position buckets, dichotomizing skin tone, collapsing card counts, exposure coding.
categories.criterion: The decision discards levels or sets a threshold/default that feeds a model or estimate; if the coarsening is only for a chart it is descriptive_summaries.

categories.name: Model form and adjustment set
categories.definition: Choices in the fitted model: which columns enter, covariate additions, dummy/reference-level encoding, clustering, and alternate specifications refit for robustness.
categories.criterion: The decision defines or alters an estimating equation or its variable set; extraction/formatting of its output is result_reporting.

categories.name: Uncertainty and significance
categories.definition: How error is quantified: manual Wald/normal-approximation CIs and SEs, error-bar multipliers, SE backed out of a bootstrap width, or a hypothesis test.
categories.criterion: The decision is the method for producing an interval, standard error, or p-value, regardless of whether it feeds a plot or a table.

categories.name: Resampling and failure handling
categories.definition: How the bootstrap or multi-fit machinery behaves: discarding under-sized or under-event draws, iteration caps, warning suppression, and silently skipping fits that raise or fail to converge.
categories.criterion: The decision governs which resampled or per-group fits are retained or dropped during repeated fitting.

categories.name: Descriptive and crude picture
categories.definition: Pre-modeling exploratory output: crude/unadjusted rate gaps, summary-statistic table contents, and distribution plots including their display binning and top-N truncation.
categories.criterion: The decision produces an unadjusted or descriptive display; if it selects among fitted-model estimates it is result_reporting.

categories.name: Reporting and estimand framing
categories.definition: Selecting which model estimates to assemble and format, naming the primary versus secondary estimand, extracting a coefficient by position, and manual cross-checks of the headline estimate.
categories.criterion: The decision concerns which adjusted results are presented, in what role, or how they are pulled and verified from the fit.
